raw_text: Violent protests against the Agnipath military recruitment scheme paralysed railway services across Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, and Haryana on Saturday. Arsonists set fire to trains and railway stations at multiple locations. The Hindustan Times has confirmed that Telegram groups were used to coordinate protest locations and share real-time updates on police deployments. The Government defended the scheme while deploying additional security forces.
clean_text: Anti-Agnipath protests paralysed railway services across Bihar, UP, and Haryana with arson at multiple stations. Telegram coordinated protest locations and police deployment updates.
